## Requirements (from the contract)

1. Versioned, READ-ONLY retained guard under docs/build/tools/ validating: 180 literal

   primary owner per adopted target, AC/layer/contributor link resolution, active-round

   ancestry, scoped historical diagnostic baseline (exact check/path/row classes; never an

2. Negative fixtures under docs/build/fixtures/ proving rejection of: omitted/duplicate/
